nodes.label: CLAUDE.md: GLUE project instructions
nodes.rationale: Project-level instructions and architecture overview; single writer per GLUE folder lease (ADR 0051); code organized by concern in src/

nodes.label: GLUE: Global Library Unified Exporter
nodes.rationale: Local-first DJ library app: builds music collections from folders and DJ-app libraries, analyses in background, manages playlists and shows. Grew from Speklone (spectral forensics).

nodes.label: crates/glue-engine: GLUE Home's library engine
nodes.rationale: Local link's /rpc, stores, jobs, repair, analysis queue. Rust implementation (ADRs 0153, 0154). Held to TypeScript by golden tests. Shared sync since 0.54 (ADR 0155).

nodes.label: crates/glue-store: library store in Rust
nodes.rationale: Rust port of src/store/collection.ts. Held byte for byte to TypeScript by tests/golden/store golden tests (ADR 0152).

nodes.label: crates/glue-rtc: GLUE Home's WebRTC connections
nodes.rationale: Rust implementation of WebRTC to other devices (ADR 0150). Speaks website's protocol (src/core/transfer.ts).

nodes.label: src/store/shared/engine.ts: sync implementation
nodes.rationale: TypeScript sync engine. Held to Rust by tests/golden/sync golden tests (ADR 0155). GLUE Home's sync ported to crates/glue-engine/src/sync.rs.
